Display sample for JA Voyara

A high-contrast serif carries display at a tight 1.14, while the sans body runs airy at 1.65; the distance between the two leadings is most of the editorial feel.

The preview intentionally uses only schema tokens so reviewers can confirm the package remains portable across OpenDesign artifacts.

Tracking belongs to the monospace layer only: the serif is set flush at zero.
